name: chessplay-monorepo
description: Real-time multiplayer chess game with React frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.dev:multi: concurrently "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run test:production && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
